author: Legoche
body:
Hello!
Here is a map of mine for the next tournament pool. I wanted to make a map that is not just about solo pushing but team pushes instead.

Gametype/Information:
TDM with Scoreboxes, Scoreboxes score 3 points on this map.

Images

Overview

YML

Download


Special thanks to:
ImRaging
Xuph
alexanderjoe
Jiveh

If you want to view it ingame, go on alexanderjoe's build server and type /mv tp Industry
Thanks for reading!
